goals: Verify that the copy button remains visible and within the viewport on a mobile device.
Verify that bold text with punctuation is rendered correctly in the preview without leaking markdown markers.
Verify bidirectional scroll synchronization between the editor and device-specific previews (mobile/tablet).
activities: Set the viewport size to mobile dimensions (width: 390, height: 844).
Navigate to the root URL.
Click on the 'Preview' tab.
Assert that the copy button is visible.
Assert that the copy button's bounding box is valid and within the viewport.
Navigate to the root URL.
Fill the editor input with markdown text containing bold punctuation ('2025年初，伦敦黄金市场的一个月拆借利率一度升至**5%**。').
Assert that the preview renders '5%' as strong text.
Assert that the preview does not contain markdown markers ('**5%**').
Assert that the preview contains the full rendered text.
Set the viewport size to desktop dimensions (width: 1440, height: 900).
Navigate to the root URL.
Fill the editor input with a long markdown content.
Click on the 'mobile' device tab.
Wait for the editor input area to become scrollable.
Wait for the preview inner scroll area to become scrollable.
Scroll the editor input to 72% of its height and wait for the preview to sync its scroll position.
Scroll the preview inner scroll area to 28% of its height and wait for the editor to sync its scroll position.
Set the viewport size to desktop dimensions (width: 1440, height: 900).
Navigate to the root URL.
Fill the editor input with a long markdown content.
Click on the 'tablet' device tab.
Wait for the editor input area to become scrollable.
Wait for the preview inner scroll area to become scrollable.
Scroll the editor input to 72% of its height and wait for the preview to sync its scroll position.
Scroll the preview inner scroll area to 28% of its height and wait for the editor to sync its scroll position.
